overview: This declaration matches what the app actually does. Camera and the photo library are for meal photos only. Email and user id are for magic-link sign-in. Meal descriptions and daily check-in taps are user content. The app does not collect location, contacts, microphone, Health Connect, purchases, advertising IDs, or analytics.

dataCollected.purpose: App functionality — photograph or choose a meal to analyse
App functionality — meal descriptions and daily check-in taps

dataNotCollected: Device or other IDs for advertising

securityPractices.deletionPath: In-app Account → Delete account, which calls DELETE /api/account/delete
